summary: You presented a well-motivated mission concept benefiting Australia, supported by STK orbit modelling and an effective synthesis in the Conclusion. To reach higher marks across all sections, address technical misconceptions regarding orbital mechanics, thoroughly proofread to remove unfinished text, replace non-academic sources like Wikipedia with primary literature, and standardise your figure and table numbering.

criteria.C1: You clearly defined the primary mission, justified using a single satellite for coral bleaching monitoring, and identified relevant stakeholders like CSIRO and BOM. To reach the top of Accomplished, integrate literature references more deeply when establishing operational requirements.
criteria.C2: You effectively utilised STK to model the 600 km orbit and evaluate ground station access. However, stating an equatorial launch maximises efficiency is incorrect for a retrograde SSO ($i = 97.8^\circ$), where Earth's rotation opposes the launch. To achieve Accomplished, ensure orbital dynamics principles are accurate and avoid truncated sentences in your EOL section.
criteria.C3: Your conclusion synthesised the major elements of the report well, directly linking your mission architecture to the Great Barrier Reef monitoring objectives. Ensure all concluding statements are reinforced with specific numerical findings from your analysis.
criteria.C4: Your report layout follows a clear engineering flow. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, ensure all visual assets include formal captions and numbers (e.g., 'Figure 1: STK 3D View...'), and replace direct Wikipedia content and raw wiki citations with verified primary academic and industry literature.

next_steps: Revisit your launch site selection analysis in 'Mission Design' to account for retrograde orbital mechanics, noting that Earth's eastward rotation incurs a delta-v penalty at inclinations greater than 90°.
Complete the truncated sentence in 'Mission Duration & EOL' detailing drag sail mechanics ('utilising a large surface area to...').
Replace all Wikipedia tables and citations throughout the report with peer-reviewed literature or official launch provider user manuals, and add formal numbered captions to all figures.
